item_name: Quantum compiler: qubit assignment + remote gate scheduling
exact_source_excerpt_or_summary: Ferrari/Carretta/Amoretti IEEE TQE vol.4 2023 (arXiv:2305.02969). Qubit assignment = METIS multilevel k-way partitioning of circuit's qubit-interaction graph (vertex=qubit, edge weight=#2-qubit gates between pair), k=target QPU count given as INPUT, refined by greedy qubit-move pass minimizing cross-partition cost. Remote gate scheduling = Algorithm 1: for each non-local gate, pick TeleData vs TeleGate by cost=(n_EPR/n_cov)*(delay/mean_decoherence_time) [Eq.1], tally EPR pairs consumed. Final circuit depth read off after local SWAP routing pass (Sec 3.3). Evaluated on VQE/QFT/graph-state circuits, heavy-hexagon coupling maps (IBM-style), Net-3/Net-5 QPU topologies.
status: obtained and read in full 2026-11-26
notes: CONFIRMS: R_j/E_j/T_j have NO closed-form formula over (circuit type, qubit count) in ref[7] or ref[8] -- all three are OUTPUTS of running this compiler pipeline, not derivable analytically. Authors' own compiler code not found published. DECIDED: scoped mini-compiler, see COMPILER row below.
